tips.text: Rank the Boltor and Kronen to 30 before crafting; the Boltace consumes both, and ranking them afterward means building them again.
Farm the 2 Argon Crystals on the day you build the Kronen; the stack halves at daily reset.
Save credits for the Kronen blueprint; it is the expensive part and the Boltace itself is cheap.
Buy the plain Boltace blueprint, not the Telos Boltace; that one is a separate syndicate weapon.
